snippet.title: Nordic Ashes - Physical Edition Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🪓 Nordic Ashes is coming in physical format to PS5 and Nintendo Switch! 🔥
Get ready to face Ragnarök in this acclaimed survival roguelite—now available in both standard and collector’s physical editions!

Developed by Noxfall Studios, Nordic Ashes: Survivors of Ragnarok immerses you in a dark, mythological world where you’ll battle endless hordes of enemies, unlock powerful upgrades, and face legendary bosses inspired by Norse mythology.

🎮 Pre-order now for PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch.

🌌 Survive. Evolve. Face the end of the world.

#NordicAshes #PS5 #NintendoSwitch #CollectorEdition #SelectaPlay #Roguelite #Ragnarok #SurvivorsOfRagnarok
